programmes.amount_note: Maximum credit of EUR 10 million for technical development projects and EUR 5 million for clinical development projects. programmes.name_en: WBSO – R&D tax credit (reduction of payroll tax / income tax)
programmes.funder: Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland (RVO), on behalf of the Ministry of Economic Affairs
programmes.amount_note: 2026 parameters as published by RVO: first bracket 36% (50% for starters) of the S&O-basis up to EUR 391,020, and 16% above that. Self-employed persons may use a fixed deduction; the flat-rate S&O hourly cost is EUR 29.
programmes.deadline_note: 'De aanvraagtermijnen verschillen voor zzp'ers en ondernemingen met personeel' — application windows differ for the self-employed and for companies with staff, and there are several application moments per year; see the RVO WBSO calendar.

procedure_steps.detail: Check that your project is development work or technical-scientific research carried out within the EU and that you pay Dutch payroll and/or income tax.
Arrange eHerkenning (minimum level 3 with RVO authorisation).
Submit the application yourself via mijn.rvo.nl within the applicable window (typically 1-4 hours of work).
After receiving the S&O-verklaring, offset the amount against payroll tax and keep an S&O administration of hours and costs.

documents_required.doc: eHerkenning level 3 or higher with RVO services authorisation
Project description of the development work / technical-scientific research

documents_required.note: Kept during the project, checked afterwards

eligibility.other_note: Open to entrepreneurs subject to Dutch payroll tax and/or income tax, including self-employed persons (zzp'ers) and starters, who carry out R&D within the EU. Starters get the enhanced 50% first-bracket rate.

programmes.source_snippet: De aanvraagtermijnen verschillen voor zzp'ers en ondernemingen met personeel. (2026: eerste schijf 36%, starters 50%, grens € 391.020, tweede schijf 16%, forfaitair uurtarief € 29.)
